entries.name: Anime Interface Pack
entries.summary: Vivid anime-inspired theme (pink, cyan, violet on plum) with two reference screens.

entries.name: Arc Blue
entries.summary: UI theme from design palette: neutral bg/surface, #004AFD as primary action. GameCore 5.1+.

entries.name: Automation History
entries.summary: A read-only window onto your automation history — the record of which rules have run, and when. The trail itself is kept by GameCore and stays empty until a rule fires.

entries.name: Battery Badge
entries.summary: A compact in-game battery and temperature badge. It reads GameCore's approved thermals feed; it cannot read charge current or battery health.

entries.name: Benchmark Suite
entries.summary: A read-only visualizer for GameCore's performance feed — live FPS, CPU, GPU and temperature as an overlay, dashboard widgets and a rolling chart. It runs no benchmark workload and computes no score.

entries.name: Charger Boost
entries.summary: A performance profile when a charger connects, not a fast-charge tool. Pins high refresh and cuts animation overhead while charging.

entries.name: Chromecore GameCore
entries.summary: Liquid chrome on true black — silver primary, blue reflection, red glint, round forms.

entries.name: Colorblind Safe
entries.summary: A high-contrast blue-and-amber theme that avoids red-green-only signalling, with read-only screens explaining each colour's job.

entries.name: Comic GameCore
entries.summary: Bright comic-book theme — bold ink on warm paper, punch red and comic blue.

entries.name: Cooldown Ladder
entries.summary: Three staged thermal rules that shed system load as the device heats, plus a low-battery backstop. Uses only GameCore's brokered actions.

entries.name: Cybercity GameCore
entries.summary: Light sky-and-pearl theme — tower blue, dusk pink, domed corners.

entries.name: Cybercore GameCore
entries.summary: Y2K blue-screen theme — CRT navy, screen-blue glow, mono type, square corners.

entries.name: Cyberpunk GameCore
entries.summary: Dark neon cyberpunk theme — cyan and magenta on near-black.

entries.name: Cybersigilism GameCore
entries.summary: Monochrome chrome-on-void theme — silver, steel, true black, sharp edges, serif type.

entries.name: Dashboard Composer
entries.summary: A deck of read-only cards for GameCore's home dashboard - live performance tiles plus sample charts you pick and arrange yourself.

entries.name: Egyptian Scarlet
entries.summary: UI theme from design palette: neutral bg/surface, #EB2F33 as primary action. GameCore 5.1+.

entries.name: Exit Restore
entries.summary: A post-game baseline, not a snapshot restore: peak refresh 120 and battery saver when charge is low. Use GameCore profiles for true per-game restore.

entries.name: Fernwood
entries.summary: UI theme from design palette: neutral bg/surface, #8B5CF6 as primary action. GameCore 5.1+.

entries.name: GameCore Personal OS
entries.summary: A personal home dashboard: a dark theme, home screens, live-vitals widgets and layout settings.

entries.name: Graphics Tuning
entries.summary: A guide to the graphics settings that actually move frame rate, with an in-game probe to check whether they did on your device. It explains and measures; it cannot change a game's renderer.

entries.name: Liquid Glass GameCore

entries.name: Local Gaming Advisor
entries.summary: Read-only gaming advice drawn from your own device's performance and thermal readings, with an optional cooldown automation you stay in control of. It reports; it does not tune your device for you.

entries.name: Midnight Lime
entries.summary: UI theme from design palette: neutral bg/surface, #C6F432 as primary action. GameCore 5.1+.

entries.name: Minimal Vitals
entries.summary: Five compact Home cards for the figures that matter: a 2×2 snapshot plus CPU, memory, battery and heat tiles.

entries.name: Navy Coral
entries.summary: UI theme from design palette: neutral bg/surface, #FF6B5B as primary action. GameCore 5.1+.

entries.name: Nebula Interface Suite
entries.summary: A true-black lavender-and-pink interface suite: glass theme, live control centre, design screens, five dashboard widgets and one real glass-intensity control.

entries.name: Night Shift
entries.summary: A warm amber-on-black interface with serif type for late sessions. A palette, not a hardware blue-light filter.

entries.name: Nothing OS Gaming
entries.summary: Monochrome true-black theme with a reserved Nothing-style red accent, plus in-game performance and battery-saver automations. No Glyph, Ndot font or Nothing hardware.

entries.name: Papercut
entries.summary: A warm paper light theme with ink-red and teal, sharp corners and serif type. No textures or images — the paper is colour and type.

entries.name: RedMagic GameCore
entries.summary: Red-on-black RedMagic theme — signature red on near-black. The jagged edges and pinwheel logo are part of the built-in Redline skin, not this plugin.

entries.name: Retro Futurism GameCore
entries.summary: Cream-paper 80s future — teal machinery, coral print, visor green, serif type.

entries.name: Robot Core GameCore
entries.summary: Porcelain-and-chrome light theme — instrument teal, warm accent, engineered edges.

entries.name: Sand & Mocha
entries.summary: UI theme from design palette: neutral bg/surface, #FC75B4 as primary action. GameCore 5.1+.

entries.name: Sensitivity Lab Pro
entries.summary: A sensitivity and DPI reference lab: a live motion overlay to feel out aim changes, copy-ready preset tables, and saved preferences. It measures and remembers — it cannot change any game's sensitivity.

entries.name: Stat Dictionary
entries.summary: A plain-language dictionary of the figures GameCore's plugin feed exposes — what each one measures, what it does not, and why an unavailable reading is a dash.

entries.name: Thermal Desk
entries.summary: A thermal-focused dashboard: battery temperature, load, a temperature trend and a three-stage plan built from GameCore's approved readings.

entries.name: True Glitch
entries.summary: Structural corruption theme — the HUD tears into displaced bands, text and panels alike.
